newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle lightly traded at $108-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle lightly traded at $108-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were quiet Thursday, with few trades at a steady $108.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, feedlot sources said.
Most of this week's showlists were sold out and managers were preparing next week's lists.
As in Texas and Kansas, Nebraska cattle are being sold ahead of schedule. This week's Nebraska sales originally scheduled to be for sale late this month, they said.
